name: local-cpu
description: Local CPU-only run against llama-server instances (no GPU, no API cost). Ports MUST match eval/serve/models.json: lfm-vl 8081, lfm-judge 8082, moondream 8083. Start the servers with eval/serve/serve.sh first (see eval/SERVING.md). Cost fields are 0 by construction — the currency here is wall-clock latency and RAM, which the runner records in results.json._summary.host and per-approach mem_available_mb_after.

lfm_vl._note: LFM2.5-VL-1.6B Q8_0 via llama-server --jinja --mmproj. llama-server ignores the model id, so any value routes to the loaded model. If it 400s on response_format, the client retries without it automatically.

lfm_judge._note: LFM2.5-2.6B Q8_0, text-only judge. llama-server converts JSON Schema to GBNF, so json_schema is expected to hold here.

moondream._note: BLOCKED as of 2026-08-11: eval/serve/models.json records status FAILED — no GGUF exists and no CPU-only runtime supports the architecture. Kept here so the approach is one served port away from runnable.

single_moondream.label: Moondream 3 single-shot — BLOCKED, not in approach_order; run explicitly with --approach single_moondream once a server exists on :8083

ensemble_lfm.label: LFM2.5-VL x5 diverse prompts (2 in flight) + LFM2.5-2.6B judge merge, CPU
